menus.note: November 3–December 6, 2026. All prices include tax. The current official interactive site explicitly lists this exact branch; Yurakucho is included by the current full site even though the release introduction lists five locations. Six 70-minute seatings: 11:00, 12:30, 14:00, 16:00, 17:30 and 19:00, with last orders 40 minutes after each start. Advance reservation ¥330/person, cutoff previous day 10:00; walk-ins only if seats available. One random coaster per collaboration food/drink; postcard for paid advance reservation. Menu/novelty stock limited. Exact allergen lists are published on the source; guests should consult current lists for dietary requirements. Official main site, linked special site, release and franchise-owner announcement checked. Branch interiors/finished collaboration installation gallery not published there; named current promotion food photos used instead. Other collaborations/branches’ menu and photos excluded.
